BBC Drama 'Sherlock' Star Confirms Return, New Series Expected

Martin Freeman, who plays Dr. John Watson in the BBC drama 'Sherlock', has confirmed that the show will return after a three-year hiatus. Freeman stated that the upcoming series is expected to be the 'best series yet'. Filming for the new season is underway, with other cast members also reportedly returning. The series, known for its modern adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's detective stories, has garnered a significant international following since its debut.
